description: Zero‑dependency native‑ESM Node.js framework that gives you Express‑style simplicity with Fastify‑grade speed, built‑in TypeScript, AI‑ready observability, and instant edge‑runtime deployment.

download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese because it eliminates every runtime dependency—no `npm install` bloat, instant start‑up, and flawless deployment to edge platforms.
